card.name: Timing adverbs like immediately, in advance
card.fires_on: Timing words that end a short phrase, mainly "immediately" in "If not used immediately", also "time" in "one tablet at a time" and "advance" or "earlier".

modes.label: If not used immediately
modes.description: The word "immediately" after "used" or "administered" in preparation and storage directions.
modes.example: If not used<< immediately>>, store the diluted POLIVY solution

modes.label: At a time
modes.description: The word "time" ending the phrase "one at a time" in preparation steps.
modes.example: Always crush one tablet at a<< time>>. 2. Measure approximately one tablespoon

modes.label: Earlier or in advance
modes.description: Timing words in general prose, often where "rather than later" may follow.
modes.example: it is better to discover this<< earlier>> rather than later so that alternative technology paths

card.writes: It pushes toward "rather than" style contrasts and away from further urgency words like immediately or sooner.
card.plain: It marks timing words such as "immediately" or "at a time" that close a phrase in preparation instructions.
